latest_release.name: v1.2.1
latest_release.body:
v1.2.1

1. Add Valorant Indicators to the KillEffect module
2. Add music box and scene recognition to the MinecraftUtils.
3. Improve Minecraft kill detection, win/loss detection, username detection, etc. 
4. Add shadow blur option to the Arraylist.
5. Convert many built-in data to online control. 
6. Add AutoInput and BlockEmudhra modules. 
7. Add smooth shadow implementation. 
8. Add support for speed adjustment and part setting commands in BiliVideoHelper.
9. Add more convenient live area options in the Streamer module. 
10. Add well-known person and user verification check to the LiveStream module. 
11. Add Bilibili Cloud mode to the speaker, but requires logging into Bilibili. 
12. Fix several issues with the Codex operator. 
13. Add filters to the Neverlose search interface. 
14. Add Youdao source to the Translator. 
15. Refactor the Neverlose about and settings interface. 
16. Fix some known issues

Zip password: Wormwake

JackalClient





### a free Hacker Client for WINDOWS (Partial Source Code, esp. UI) ### It's not a Minecraft Ghost Client XD. The repo serves solely as a download channel, and the project is still under active development. ### Just looks like ### Zip extract password: Wormwake ### Subscribe [@Wormwaker](https://space.bilibili.com/3494361276877525) ### 's Bilibili Channel ### Please check: - [Official Website](https://www.wormwake.com/jackalclient) - [Documentation](https://doc.wormwake.com) ### Bilibili Videos - [\[English\] JackalClient Summer Trailer 2026](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1t1Nj65EZn/?p=2) - [最强 Windows 美化工具箱 Jackal Client 下载与使用教程，小白也能看懂](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1vTMR6vELJ) - [Re: 当我把 Vape 开到 Windows 上？ ft.JackalClientAlpha](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV12sPCzfEyZ) - find out more: - [https://space.bilibili.com/3494361276877525/channel/collectiondetail?sid=3986082](https://space.bilibili.com/3494361276877525/channel/collectiondetail?sid=3986082) ### QQ Channel: - Click the link to join our Tencent channel【JackalClient】：[https://pd.qq.com/s/8s4nsdc81?b=9](https://pd.qq.com/s/8s4nsdc81?b=9) ### Project Start Date 2024/8/10 Thanks for your support ![Alt](https://repobeats.axiom.co/api/embed/5d5e3bf7d00d84c5c6ba9273aca43f9bd536cd09.svg "Repobeats analytics image") ## Modules Overview All modules are classified into 10 categories: Combat, Window, Process, Registry, File, Control, Render, Web, Misc, Driver Nice modules you can't miss: - **AntiCapture:** Makes client window invisible from screenrecording software. - **ClearPin:** Clear Windows PIN. - **Gatekeeper:** Intercept some winlogin events, like Ctrl+Alt+Delete, Shutdown, Reboot, Logoff etc. - **TrustedInstaller:** Get trustedinstaller privilege. - **WindowHighlight:** Draw a rectangle on the activated window and a dark background beneath it. - **OpacityChanger:** Allows you to adjust window opacity using mouse wheel. - **ConsoleESP:** Monitor console changes. It can also real-time output content of other consoles. - **AntiPopups:** Helps you get rid of popups. - **DialogEscape:** Automatically close message boxes. - **PrivateWindow:** Make some private windows (e.g. Edge, QQ, WeChat) excluded from screenrecording software. - **ProcessManager:** An built-in application which can manage your processes. - **CompileESP:** Monitor C/C++ compilation start and end. - **SecurityESP:** Show a HUD of antimalware and malware process. - **ProcessESP:** Show process creation and exit and notify you. - **Injector:** Simple injection tool. It supports simple reflective injection. - **FileManager:** An built-in application which can manage your files. - **UpdateDisabler:** Delay Windows update automatically. - **AutoClicker:** Helps you click. - **MouseESP:** Draw multiple beautiful mouse effects. - **ColorPicker:** Show color info your cursor points at. - **Crosshair:** Draw a crosshair. - **SnapTap:** Simple snap-tap module. - **Keystrokes:** Show AWSD game keystrokes. - **Keystrokes2:** Show dynamic keystrokes in one or multiple rows. - **KeySound:** Highly customizable key sound module. You can use a config file. - **ClipboardESP:** Show text or bitmap info in your clipboard (what you just copied). - **AutoL:** Automatically send *** texts in some Minecraft occasions. No injection involved. It depends on the logs of the game. - **ClipboardTweaks:** Approach your copied text. It includes high obfuscation methods. - **Typewriter:** Helps you type specified content at a very fast speed. - **Shell:** Client CLI, with a large command system. Check COMMANDS.txt for more information. - **Arraylist:** Just like the module list in any Minecraft cheat. Shows the names of the enabled modules. - **AudioVisualizer:** Show the audio waveform or other forms of visualization. - **BetterLyrics:** Hook Netease Cloudmusic and show realtime lyrics. - **Scoreboard:** Scoreboard just like the one in Minecraft. - **TimeDisplay:** Show current time. - **MotionBlur:** Simulated screen motion blur effect. - **Clock:** A customizable clock. - **Island:** A simple dynamic island, which can sync notification, task progress and music lyrics. - **FancyText:** Show text in a fancy way. Similar to PV effects. - **Stuck:** Fake stuck. - **Gamma:** Brighten your monitor. - **Vape:** Draw VAPE logo on the top of arraylist. - **AntiRickroll:** No rickroll. - **TcpMonitor:** Monitor TCP connections and notify you. - **TcpKiller:** Terminate TCP connections. - **LiveStream:** Bilibili livestream utilities. - **QuakeWarning:** Notify the earthquake information. - **BiliNotifier:** Bilibili notification sync. - **BiliFans:** Monitor Bilibili follower amount and notify changes. - **AntiMicrophone:** Mutes your mic. - **TimeManager:** Set, offset or accelerate your system time. - **Volume:** Helps you adjust system/process volume using mouse wheel. - **AudioIsolation:** Adjust process volumes to promise only one process can make sounds. **...and more (400+ modules)** ## Premium Subscription - You can upgrade your client to PRO edition if you like, which has a lot of unique *options, modules and commands* and a faster update. - Check it out: ![Get Jackal Pro](https://afdian.com/item/1eda4ca6ca2511f0a7ae52540025c377)
